quotes.dwitbuk:review: Commit `reviews/<id>.json` — it is a record like a run.
quotes.plugin:chongdae: chongdae: no run in progress — the run is the agent's container, so Edit/Write are refused until one starts: `python3 "<plugin:chongdae>/chongdae.py" init --session --goal "..."` (tasks added as you go) or `... init --plan FILE`.

findings.why: The review member requires writing and committing a review artifact, while the current chongdae mode refuses edits and writes until a run starts.

quotes.hacheong:build: Make the checks pass by changing the code, not the tests.

findings.why: The build worker is instructed to modify code, but the standing chongdae mode refuses edits while no run is in progress.

quotes.hacheong:nitpick: You write the tests that will decide a contract, before anyone builds it, and you write them to make the builder fail.

findings.why: The nitpick member requires writing test files for this situation, while the chongdae mode refuses all Edit/Write actions because no run is in progress.

situations.situation: trying the product as a newcomer

quotes.hunsu:compose: 2. Exit 2: the last line (`decision: ...`) is a question for the user. Ask it as is. Apply the answer — `hunsu add <plugin>`, an edit to `hunsu.json` (`engines`, `resolutions`, `local-hooks-ok` for a hook the whole team runs), `local-hooks-ok` in `hunsu.local.json` for a user-level hook that is only this person's (not committed), or the judge round (`judge request` → `judge_worker.py` per packet → `judge consume`; then show the user `hunsu-conflicts.md` and propose `resolutions`, marking any they did not read "reviewed": false) — and run step 1 again.
quotes.plugin:chongdae: chongdae: no run in progress — the run is the agent's container, so Edit/Write are refused until one starts: `python3 "<plugin:chongdae>/chongdae.py" init --session --goal "..."` (tasks added as you go) or `... init --plan FILE`. The engine is that file; there is no `chongdae` binary.

findings.why: hunsu:compose permits and requires editing project manifests during the lock flow, while plugin:chongdae refuses Edit/Write because no run is in progress.

quotes.mangsang:operate: After a slice: propose relations in a `proposals.json` — `{"relations": [{"src", "predicate", "dst", "evidence"}]}` — the slice's section/symbols/tests each `realizes concept:NAME` (evidence quotes the concept's `means` or the projection's text), plus plan-section↔symbol (`documents`) and test↔symbol (`verifies`) where they say more than the concept does.
quotes.plugin:chongdae: chongdae: no run in progress — the run is the agent's container, so Edit/Write are refused until one starts: `python3 "<plugin:chongdae>/chongdae.py" init --session --goal "..."` (tasks added as you go) or `... init --plan FILE`.

findings.why: mangsang:operate requires writing relation artifacts and declarations, while plugin:chongdae forbids Edit/Write while no run is active.
